Ready to take on an entrepreneurial challenge and shape the future of furniture? Then this is your chance!
Kick off with a short onboarding in our Berlin office before heading straight to Shanghai, China. There, you’ll be in the driver’s seat: pushing forward strategic projects, creating exciting new products, and building strong partnerships on the ground. With your entrepreneurial spirit and data-driven mindset, you’ll own the full journey – from product development all the way to stakeholder management in China.
Join us as a Junior Business Development Manager (m/f/d) at CHECK24 Möbel GmbH and launch your very own adventure in Shanghai.

Was Du mitbringst:

- Willingness to live and work in China (Shanghai) for at least 2 years and to travel frequently within China and to other Asian countries to visit partners
- Ability to communicate in Mandarin and English (or German) fluently
- A strong academic background, e.g. in Economics, Entrepreneurship, Business Administration, Business Intelligence, Marketing, or a related field
- Ability to operate and succeed in a fast-paced, fast-changing environment
- Experience in procurement, supply chain or business development is a plus

Zu Deinen Aufgaben zählen:

- Expand and maintain strong relationships with manufacturers and stakeholders in China
- Negotiate prices, quantities, delivery dates and assert our interests
- Contribute to the development of new products, while taking full ownership for ensuring product quality
- Work closely with the team at the Berlin headquarter to ensure seamless integration of global activities

Was wir Dir bieten:

- Kick-start your career – be part of an exciting new project from day one and take on challenging and diverse tasks where you’ll have real responsibility right from the start
- Ownership from day one – we give you plenty of room for initiative. Share your ideas, take charge of your projects, and directly shape the success of CHECK24!
- Events & team spirit – we live collaboration both at work and beyond – whether it’s lunch together, a quick foosball match, after-work drinks, or celebrating our successes at regular team and company events.

What to Expect

Tesla is seeking an Account Manager for residential energy sales in Germany. Your core responsibility is B2B sales of Tesla residential and small commercial energy products, with a primary focus on Powerwall 3P — Tesla’s three-phase home battery and integrated inverter, purpose-built for the German and European grid. Following the launch of Powerwall 3P in Germany, you will scale adoption through distributors and third-party installers, grow a high-performing partner network, and drive business development in your region. We are looking for an experienced commercial professional with a background in PV or energy storage. Beyond strong execution and a team-oriented mindset, successful candidates bring creativity, passion, and the drive to lead in a fast-moving technology and market landscape. * This position can be based anywhere in Germany.

What You’ll Do

- Achieve Powerwall 3P and Wall Connector sales targets within assigned channel(s) in Germany
- Build and grow relationships across partner organizations (distributors, installers, and related channels), clearly communicating Tesla’s product portfolio, three-phase value proposition, and feature roadmap
- Drive partner readiness and ramp for Powerwall 3P: onboarding, enablement, pipeline building, and conversion from interest to installed systems
- Evaluate new business opportunities with existing and new accounts and/or sales channels, match suitable product offerings (including Powerwall 3P for three-phase residential and small commercial sites), and own capture of those opportunities
- Deliver market insights to the broader business — including competitive dynamics, installer feedback, and adoption barriers/opportunities specific to three-phase storage in Germany
- Provide accurate sales forecasts to business and manufacturing teams, reflecting Powerwall 3P ramp and channel mix
- Support assessment of market dynamics across sectors (utility, C&I, residential) and drivers (policy/regulatory, economics, grid requirements, incentive programs)
- Represent Tesla at sales and marketing events promoting Powerwall and Powerwall 3P
- Identify and support initiatives that improve partner training, installation quality, fulfilment, and Tesla support — with particular focus on three-phase design, commissioning, and backup use cases
- Provide user and customer feedback to IT on Tesla tools/systems and to Operations on processes

What You’ll Bring

- 5+ years in account management or channel sales within the PV or energy storage industry
- Strong understanding of residential/small commercial energy storage, ideally including three-phase (3P) systems, hybrid inverters, and grid-tied architectures common in Germany
- Working knowledge of grid/utility markets, grid connection practices, and relevant German/EU regulatory and incentive frameworks
- Excellent communication and documentation skills
- Ability to prioritize and run multiple projects and partner workstreams in parallel
- Fluency in English and German
- Flexibility to travel within Germany (and occasionally the broader region)

jobs.occupation: VPP Operations Specialist – Germany (m/w/d) (Bau- und Projektkaufmann/-frau)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

We are scaling our Virtual Power Plant (VPP) operations into the German energy market and are looking for a hands-on VPP Operations Specialist – Germany to support that growth from day one. We need someone who can roll up their sleeves, own exceptions end-to-end, and bring deep practical knowledge of how the German energy market operates at a process and regulatory level.You will be embedded in our Operations team, working closely with our flexibility, settlements, and support functions across the globe. A key part of your role will be upskilling our support staff on German market workflows, participant journeys, and exception handling – ensuring the whole team can operate confidently as we grow our German footprint.

What You’ll Do

Market Operations

- Apply working knowledge of the German energy regulatory landscape (BNetzA, BDEW) to day-to-day operational tasks.
- Manage and resolve data flow exceptions relating to MaKo/EDIFACT messaging, GPKE, and WiM processes, and MSB/VNB interactions.
- Support the accurate management of MaLo and MeLo data, ensuring data integrity across systems.
- Work within the MsbG metering framework and support smart meter rollout processes relevant to VPP-connected assets.
- Demonstrate solid understanding of MaBis processes.
- Monitor Bilanzkreis and settlement obligations relevant to our flexible asset portfolio in Germany.Flexibility Participant & Exception Management
- Act as the primary handler for escalated exceptions arising from the German flexibility participant journey – from asset registration through to settlement and payment queries.
- Own complex cases end-to-end, coordinating across internal teams (settlements, tech, finance) to reach resolution.
- Identify recurring issues and escalate systemic root causes with clear data and recommended fixes.
- Support onboarding of new German flexibility participants and asset owners, ensuring a smooth and compliant process.Training & Knowledge Transfer
- Design and deliver structured training sessions for UK-based support staff covering German market processes, regulatory obligations, and participant workflows.
- Build and maintain clear, practical playbooks, process guides, and FAQs for use by the wider support team.
- Conduct regular knowledge gap assessments and adjust training content accordingly.
- Review training effectiveness and iterate based on team performance and feedback.Process Improvement & Efficiency
- Actively identify manual or repetitive tasks and find ways to reduce effort through process redesign or tooling.
- Maintain up-to-date process documentation in a clear, accessible format.
- Flag regulatory or process changes in the German market that may impact operations and recommend responses.

What You’ll Bring

Candidates should be able to demonstrate practical working knowledge across most of the following:

- BNetzA regulatory framework and BDEW market rules
- MaKo communication standards and EDIFACT message types
- GPKE (supplier switching) and WiM (metering point management) processes
- MsbG obligations and the role of the Messstellenbetreiber (MSB)
- MaLo (market location) and MeLo (metering location) data structures
- Bilanzkreis management and balancing group settlement
- German electricity billing structures including Netzentgelte and Grundversorgung vs. competitive supply frameworks
- Direktvermarktung framework
- MaBis processes for balancing group settlement reconciliation
- FCR/aFRR/mFFR prequalification and flexibility market participation rules (desirable)Essential
- Fluent in English and German (written and spoken), with experience communicating with German counterparts and producing documentation in both languages
- Demonstrable hands-on experience working within the German energy market at an operational level (a minimum of 3 years)
- Proven ability to manage exceptions and complex operational cases end-to-end
- Experience designing and delivering training or knowledge transfer programmes
- Strong analytical mindset with a practical, solutions-first approach
- Comfortable working autonomously and picking up tasks without needing close directionDesirable
- Experience with MaKo-compliant systems or EDIFACT messaging tools
- Knowledge of MSB obligations and smart meter rollout processes in Germany
- Experience working across multiple European energy markets
- Experience in a scale-up or market entry environment

What to Expect

At Tesla Engineering Germany GmbH in Freiburg, we’re building the future of sustainable energy by developing innovative power electronics for energy storage and vehicle charging systems. Join our team to collaborate across different engineering areas, solve meaningful challenges creatively and transfer concepts from initial design, through prototyping and testing into real-world solutions.This is an opportunity to own key projects, use modern tools, and work in state-of-the-art facilities to create technologies that shape how energy systems evolve. You get to work on advancing power electronics used for Tesla products globally, thereby directly contributing to the acceleration of the world's transition to sustainable energy. 

What You’ll Do

- Implement effective layout design practices into complex multilayer PCBs while meeting efficiency, cost and reliability
- Work effectively with cross functional teams to ensure design requirements are met
- Provide feedback and solutions on the board level for the issues related to hardware, electrical, mechanical, thermal and manufacturing
- Optimize PCB design to minimize DFM/DFT issues as indicated by vendors
- Generate documentation for PCB fabrications and assembly

What You’ll Bring

- 3+ years of relevant circuit board design experience including IPC standards and practices
- Proficiency in PCB design using fine pitch BGA with multilayer PCB boards
- Expertise in working with Cadence Allegro and/or Altium Designer
- Experience with power supply and switching regulators layout
- Work with vendors and manufactures to resolve issues related to PCB fabrications and assembly

For the International Montessori School **in Berlin-Wannsee **we are looking for an

English-Speaking Primary School Teacher

Ref. Nr. 376DR-BA

Your Employer

Montessori & Friends Education gGmbH is an innovative educational institution that runs several children’s centres, the International Bilingual Montessori Primary School and its own Montessori Academy. These facilities create nurturing learning environments for children based on the educational philosophy of Maria Montessori. At the primary school, 130 children learn in mixed-age groups on the grade-levels 1-6. The historic school building is situated in an idyllic location not far from Lake Wannsee. The opening of a secondary school on the same site is planned for the 2026/27 academic year. The school’s aim is to promote self-directed learning and support the holistic development of the children. Another key focus of the school is bilingual education. Around half of the pupils come from English-speaking or bilingual homes and are taught bilingually from grade 1 in both German and English.

Your Responsibilities

As a teacher, you will guide a maximum of 24 students in mixed-age learning groups (grades 1–3) and provide them with individualized support. You will be actively supported by a co-teacher. You will teach all standard elementary school subjects exclusively in English and work according to the principles of Montessori pedagogy. A trusting partnership with parents is just as important as your own creative freedom.

The school offers you 

- a permanent, full-time position,
- competitive compensation, as well as additional benefits and bonuses,
- Childcare spots for your own children in the school’s own daycare centers and at the school, subject to availability,
- regular professional development opportunities and a chance to gain an internationally recognized Montessori-Diploma,
- a supportive team and a friendly, family-like work environment.

This opportunity is for you if

- you have a teaching qualification recognised in the Federal State of Berlin, such as a Master of Education, a German 2. Staatsexamen für die Grundschule/Sekundarstufe I, a foreign teaching degree, or (N)QTS.
- you have already gained experience teaching English at the primary school level,
- you have a Montessori diploma or practical Montessori experience, and the willingness to earn a Montessori diploma while working at the school,
- you have a minimum of a C1 level in English and a minimum of a B1 level in German,
- you enjoy working in a team and cooperating closely with parents and caregivers.

Have we piqued your interest?

If so, we look forward to receiving your application, including your CV and details of your relevant qualifications.
